scripts.setup: npm run setup:web && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev:api: mkdir -p backend/storage && cd backend && INKY_DATABASE_URL=${INKY_DATABASE_URL:-sqlite:///./storage/inky.db} INKY_DATA_DIR=${INKY_DATA_DIR:-./storage} .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && backend/.venv/bin/python -m compileall backend/app
